steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Planka at http://127.0.0.1:8104/ using email admin@example.com and password exactly {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}. Verify the signed-in app is open and report confirmation.
02-report: On the board Bench Board in project Bench Project, read and report the exact names of all cards whose names start with 'Seed:'; do not modify any cards, and verify they're on that board.

03-create: On Bench Board in Bench Project, create a card named '{{runid}} Bench Card' in the In Progress list. Set its description to exactly one paragraph containing the runid {{runid}} and save it, then verify the card appears in In Progress and the saved description contains the runid once.

04-remove: Update the card '{{runid}} Bench Card' on Bench Board so its only label is the existing board label exactly named 'Hardware' (not similarly named labels). Remove any other labels if present, do not create a label, and verify the saved card has exactly Hardware and no others.

05-remove: Update card '{{runid}} Bench Card' on Bench Board so its only member is the existing user exactly named 'Bench Tester', not 'Bench Tester Lead'. Remove any other members if present, do not create a user, then verify the saved member assignment is exactly Bench Tester.
06-set: Set the due date on card '{{runid}} Bench Card' on Bench Board to 2026-12-31 (any time), save it, and verify the card shows that due date after reopening.
07-add: From the own view/page of card '{{runid}} Bench Card', add a comment whose text includes the exact runid {{runid}}, then verify the saved comment appears in the card's activity/comments.

08-open: Open the own page/view of card '{{runid}} Bench Card' and report the exact card ID as shown in the browser address path /cards/<id>. Verify the card page URL and confirm the saved card details remain present.
